Class ClientBLL

java.lang.Object
BusinessLogic.ClientBLL
public class ClientBLL extends Object
Business Logic Layer (BLL) class for managing operations related to Clients. This class acts as an intermediary between the data access layer (ClientDAO) and the rest of the application, providing methods to find, insert, and update clients.

It includes validation to handle cases where clients are not found.

Example usage: 

 ClientBLL clientBLL = new ClientBLL();
 Client client = clientBLL.findClientByID(1);
 List<Client> clients = clientBLL.findAllClients();
 clientBLL.insertClient(new Client(...));
 clientBLL.updateClient(existingClient);
